summary: Shows turning UAC off by setting EnableLUA to 0 with win_regedit and rebooting if changed, warning that this and SeTcbPrivilege create security risks.
questions: How do I disable UAC on Windows with Ansible?
Is it safe to disable UAC for become?

answer_card.title: Disabling UAC
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- win_regedit:
    path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\policies\system
    name: EnableLUA
    data: 0
    type: dword
    state: present
  register: uac_result
- win_reboot:
  when: uac_result is changed
```

Turning off UAC or granting `SeTcbPrivilege` can create security vulnerabilities.
